description: The Maps and Data page of the PISLM portal for Dominica presents spatial information for sustainable land management on the island and points to DomiNode, Dominica's public GIS repository, for full datasets. The page read on 2026-09-28 describes thematic maps of protected areas (forest reserves, marine reserves, national parks and proposed buffer zones covering 203.8 km², about 27% of the island), the 1967 soil map with over 100 legend classes combining soil type, slope and erosion, forestry management zones and watershed management units, with explanations of the agencies responsible. Coverage is Dominica. Access is free to view; no licence is stated, and downloads are referred to DomiNode, which was not opened. Caveats: several maps are old (the soil map dates from 1967), and the page is descriptive, not a data service. It supports land cover, soil and watershed context for landslide and flood exposure studies of Dominica's roads and water catchments. Related record: the Dominica 2011 census housing report complements it with dwelling data.
